_comment: Shenzhen Stock Exchange (SZSE) equity trading calendar. The closure ranges below are the SZSE notice's own '...至...休市' ranges; nothing is inferred from Shanghai, from a prior year, or from the State Council schedule. Years not listed read UNKNOWN.
source: Shenzhen Stock Exchange notice 关于2026年部分节假日休市安排的通知 (2025-12-22)
segment: SZSE equities (A-shares). Lunch break and closing call are venue phases in src/markets/venues.py (XSHE), not calendar data.

notes: Make-up working weekends (调休) are NOT trading days: the notice declares each of them '周末休市'. The engine reads every weekend as closed; they are listed so the closure is explicit.
The lunch break (11:30-13:00) is a BREAK phase, not a close; the closing call auction runs 14:57-15:00.
limitations: Years before 2026 and from 2027 read UNKNOWN. The 2027 schedule depends on the State Council's 2027 holiday notice and the exchange notice that follows it (normally late in the preceding year); neither is transcribed here.

Related SZSE reminder notices exist for each 2026 closure (t20260206_618970 春节, t20260331_619774 清明节, t20260423_620142 劳动节, general/t20260611_620979 端午节, t20260917_622911 中秋节/国庆节); their titles were seen in the search index, their contents were not retrieved.
cross_checks: exchange_calendars 4.13.2 XSHG (Shanghai, an independent dataset) has exactly the same 19 weekday closures in 2026. It is a consistency check only and is NOT used to answer for Shenzhen.
